sites.name: Display name
sites.cookie_fields_hint: The probe script reads document.cookie (set on pv, or same-origin script proxy) and POSTs allowlisted names in the open/ingest body to gv. HttpOnly cookies on www are not readable. Sensitive names (token/password/secret/jwt/credential/apikey) are never captured.
sites.embed_token_ph: Minted when the site is created
sites.embed_token_hint: Pass ?grt= on /gr.js. The server issues the pin only for this site. Rotating invalidates old URLs immediately.
sites.embed_token_rotate_confirm: Old script URLs will 403 immediately. Update every embed snippet. Continue?
sites.r3_warn: upload_ingest=first_party proxies upload and breaks JA4 / real IP. Save is rejected unless GR_ALLOW_FIRST_PARTY_UPLOAD=1.
sites.r3_reject: Proxied upload is forbidden. Set upload path to gv (or pv) bound-domain direct.
sites.require_id_roots: site_id and root domains are required
sites.consent_text: I have informed visitors of the probe behavior and obtained/arranged the required consent
sites.consent_required: Confirm visitor disclosure before creating the site
sites.domains_pick_site_hint: Pick a site first, then register its domains
sites.runtime_needs_restart: Applied; bind changes need a process restart (set GR_ADMIN_RESTART_CMD to automate)
sites.direct_hint: Direct edge: script {script} · ingest {api} (Pingora TLS, per-host SNI certs, no reverse proxy)
sites.direct_hint_unbound: This site has no pv/gv origin bound: set the script/API origins in the form above and save

retention.title: Retention policy
retention.note: Background cleanup deletes a small batch of old rows at a time. It never wipes the whole table.
retention.purge_confirm: Run one small delete batch against the probe store? This cannot be undone.
retention.note_encoding: Results are stored compactly. Optional encryption is configured on the server.
retention.note_cold: Older probe payloads move to a compact archive and expire with the cold TTL.
retention.note_pg: Dashboards read a compact latest-result table so they stay fast.
retention.note_purge: Cleanup deletes a limited number of old rows per run. It never wipes the whole table.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.note: Configure third-party IP intelligence. Secrets are stored server-side and masked in the UI.

workers.note: These change how many jobs run in parallel. They take effect immediately.

config.note: Runtime tuning: rate limits, flood hardening, hot/cold tiers, analyze triggers. Save a draft, then publish — the publishing node applies immediately, other nodes within 30s.
config.hot_hint: Hot: no restart (workers, limits, tiers, triggers)
config.group_rate: Rate limits (site totals default 0 = unlimited; client_event adds a per-IP cap)
config.rate_limit_open_per_min_hint: Session opens per site per minute; 0 = unlimited (default)
config.rate_limit_ingest_per_min_hint: Probe batch uploads per site per minute; 0 = unlimited (default)
config.rate_limit_analyze_per_min_hint: Direct analyze calls per site per minute; 0 = unlimited (default)
config.rate_limit_complete_per_min_hint: Complete receipts per site per minute; 0 = unlimited (default)
config.rate_limit_result_per_min_hint: Result reads per site per minute; 0 = unlimited (default)
config.rate_limit_client_event_per_min_hint: Client events per site per minute; 0 = unlimited (default)
config.rate_limit_client_event_per_ip_per_min_h: Client events per single IP per minute (default 100; 0 = unlimited). Exceeding caps only that IP — other visitors unaffected
config.robot_fastlane_enabled_hint: UA-declared crawlers: no L1/L3 storage, no analyze arms — early verdict stands
config.arm_sweep_interval_ms_hint: Min gap between demote/re-arm sweeps on ingest
config.arm_sweep_cap_hint: Max sessions armed per sweep (result-less only)
config.analyze_claim_batch_flood_hint: Worker claim batch while pending > soft cap
config.cold_ttl_ms_hint: L3 cold rows purged after this
config.cold_promote_window_ms_hint: How far back cold promote looks on return visits
config.analyze_idle_upload_ms_hint: Trigger analysis after this upload quiet
config.complete_on_commercial_silicon_hint: Commercial silicon + B10x done → cycle complete/cool

modules.auto_window_hint: HH:MM-HH:MM, cross-midnight ok (22:00-06:00), comma list ok; empty = unrestricted. Only runtime+restart honor the window — modules and assets are hot.
modules.auto_hold_ok: Auto upgrade paused (timer will not apply)
modules.layers_desc: Switch URL to a new release, then install modules and site assets without SSH. Runtime binary changes need a short restart. With auto-apply checked: the in-service hot thread follows the desired version for modules+assets (needs GR_AUTO_OTA_HOT=1), while a root timer applies runtime+restart inside the maintenance window with an automatic rollback+hold on health-gate failure.
modules.confirm_full: Upgrade the checked items? A runtime restart briefly takes the console offline.
modules.confirm_runtime: Download a new runtime and restart the service?

lb.title: Multi-node load balancing
lb.mode_hint: Gateway nodes must run with GR_PROBE_MODE=lb so the frontend routes through this pool (docs/guides/08-LB-MODULE.md).
lb.bad_json: Node weights / CIDR rules are not valid JSON

dsar.title: Data subject requests (DSAR / GDPR)
dsar.value_ph: vt_… / device id / IP / site id
dsar.note: Export returns every row held for the subject as JSON. Erase cascade-deletes it across hot/warm/cold stores and is IRREVERSIBLE. The selector is stored in the audit log as a sha256 fingerprint only, never in clear.
dsar.erase_confirm: Permanently erase ALL data for {kind} = “{value}”? This cannot be undone.
dsar.erase_type_prompt: Type the subject value “{value}” to confirm irreversible erasure.
